message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: construction without qualification, safety negligence leading to death of worker. This is a production safety accident. In Chinese criminal law, causing death due to safety negligence is "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident) or "以危险方法危害公共安全罪"? Actually for safety production accidents, there is a specific crime: "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident) under Article 133 of Criminal Law (formerly). The examples earlier: first two examples with mining accident and forklift accident were labeled "重大责任事故". So this case is similar: safety negligence leading to death. So answer: 重大责任事故.

Thus final answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
